heading: Central Bureau of the International Map of the World on the Millionth Scale; authorization of appropriations
lead: There is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any money in the Treasury not otherwise appropriated, an annual sum of $50 as a contribution on the part of the United States toward the expenses incurred by the Central Bureau of the International Map of the World on the Millionth Scale.
